annotations.title: Compare page with top search results

description: Compares a page of the site with the pages ranking in the top 10 for a search phrase: title, meta description, H1-H3 structure and heading topics, word count, paragraphs, links, images, dates and structured data. Returns the client values, medians for the top results, a list of gaps ordered by impact and heading topics the top results cover that the page does not. Uses competitor_urls when given (for example from a web search); otherwise Anole fetches the current Google top 10 when its search API is configured. Analysed pages count towards the plan quota.

competitor_urls.description: Up to 10 URLs ranking for the phrase, best first. Optional when Anole search is configured.

country.description: Google market for the Anole search, e.g. Poland, Germany, United States. Defaults from the site language.

language.description: Search language code, e.g. pl, en. Defaults to the site language.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

url.description: Page on the site to compare

name: compare_with_top_results
title: Compare page with top search results
